thread:
Elena: Heads-up: PR #812 (examples/snippets) is blocked by docs lint and an image path. We want to merge in today's 15:00 PST window. Can someone take reviewer ownership and run the preview so we know it's green?

Omar: I can pick it up for review but will need a quick hand with the preview URL if the bot fails. I have a hard stop at 14:50 for interviews.

Kai: I can run the preview and follow up. @docs-lint-bot show the current error?

docs-lint-bot: Lint report for PR #812 requested by Kai

```
ERROR: docs-lint: image-not-found: docs/guides/snippets/usage.md: line 12 -> ../assets/diagrams/auth-flow.png
Suggestion: verify file exists or update path to /assets/img/auth-flow.png
```

Priya: That path changed when we flattened the assets dir last sprint. Quick fix is to update the relative path to `/assets/img/auth-flow.png` or move the file. Which do you prefer?

Elena: Please update the MD to the new canonical path and keep the original filename. Also add a tiny changelog bullet: `docs: fix image path in snippets (PR #812)`. We need that for release notes.

Kai: I pushed a commit (def45) updating paths and ran `mkdocs build --strict`. Local build succeeded. Kicking preview: https://deploy.preview/pr/812/1 (status: running)

release-bot: Preview build started for PR #812 by Kai.

docs-lint-bot: Preview complete for PR #812 1: status: success. No remaining lint errors.

Omar: LGTM on the content changes. Two small nits: tighten the code example indentation and mention which SDK version the snippets target. Can someone add that as a follow-up or within this PR?

Priya: I can add a one-line SDK note in the snippets file and push a follow-up commit.

Elena: Good. Who will perform the actual merge at 15:00 PST? I can if Jen/Marco are busy. We try to keep merges in the single merge window to avoid race conditions.

Kai: I will hold off merging until 15:00 and will re-trigger preview 5 minutes before merge.

release-bot: Reminder: scheduled merge window at 15:00 PST today.

Priya: Pushed commit ghi678 adding `Note: examples target SDK v1.2.x` to the top of the snippets doc. Ran `mkdocs build --strict` locally, all green.

Omar: Approved. Tagging as ready-to-merge. :white_check_mark:

Kai: Final preview run before merge: https://deploy.preview/pr/812/2 (status: success). Design and lint green.

release-bot: PR #812 merged at 15:02 PST by Kai. Release pipeline will pick up changelog entries.

Elena: Thanks all. Quick retrospective: we hit this because assets were moved and the reviewer rotation didn't catch the change. I'm going to update the reviewer-rotation doc to include a weekly asset-path smoke test for the on-call reviewer.

Omar: If the rotation needs shuffling, I'm happy to swap a slot next week.

Priya: Also created a tiny follow-up PR to add the SDK version to other snippets.

Kai: Closing thread 1: moving PR state to merged/cleanup.
